{{Top|leg}}
[[File:KitFisto.jpg|thumb|Kit Fisto using his underwater lightsaber on Dac.]]
A '''bifurcating cyclical-ignition pulse''' (also called '''Waterproof Casing'''<ref name="JATM">''[[Jedi Academy Training Manual]]''</ref>) was a pulse that enabled a [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] to activate [[Water/Legends|underwater]] with the help of two crystals. Without special modifications, a lightsaber submerged underwater would short out and would require minor repairs before working again.<ref name="JATM" />

[[Kit Fisto/Legends|Kit Fisto's]] [[Kit Fisto's lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] had a bifurcating cyclical-ignition pulse. He was observed using his underwater lightsaber on during the [[Battle of Mon Calamari (Clone Wars)/Legends|first]] and [[Battle of Mon Cala/Legends|second]] battles of [[Dac/Legends|Mon Calamari]]. He would later record in the [[Great Holocron/Legends|Great Holocron]] an explanation of how the pulse worked, and instructions on how to modify lightsabers to add the feature.<ref name="Jedi-v-Sith">[[Jedi vs. Sith: The Essential Guide to the Force (real-life book)|''Jedi vs. Sith: The Essential Guide to the Force'']]</ref> His modification became widely used by Jedi Knights during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], where battles were fought on the water worlds of [[Kamino/Legends|Kamino]] and Dac.<ref name="Jedi-v-Sith" /> [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano's]] [[Ahsoka Tano's lightsabers/Legends|lightsaber]] and [[Shoto lightsaber/Legends|shoto]] were both able to function underwater.

[[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] would discover that [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker's]] [[Anakin Skywalker's second lightsaber/Legends|second lightsaber]] was waterproof.<ref name="Jedi-v-Sith" /> He later added this feature to his own [[Luke Skywalker's green lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]].<ref name="Star Wars 1977 87">[[Star Wars (1977) 87|''Star Wars'' (1977) 87]]</ref><ref name="Star Wars 102">[[Star Wars (1977) 102|''Star Wars'' (1977) 102]]</ref> By [[24 ABY/Legends|24 ABY]], Luke's [[Jedi Praxeum]] students had already created lightsabers with the pulse as part of their regular design, rather than as an optional choice. The ancient lightsaber that [[Anja Gallandro]] had bought and formerly owned was waterproof, as was [[Cilghal]]'s. The [[Imperial Knight]]s also had this feature.
